newsitem.title: USA: Abbey National, Willis to merge operations.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National, Willis to merge operations.

text.p: Abbey National Plc and Willis Corroon Group Plc said on Tuesday they had agreed to merge their financial adviser operations into a new company known as Willis National.

Willis Corroon will own 51 percent of the new company, while 49 percent will be owned by Abbey National, the companies said in a statement. The transaction is expected to close by the end of the year.

Net assets to be transferred to Willis National are valued at 1.72 million pounds sterling for Abbey National and 6.28 million pounds sterling for Willis Corroon, which includes a cash payment by Willis Corroon of 2.2 million pounds sterling.
